title: chore(deps): bump @objectstack/spec to ^9.0.0 — dataset-bound report migration (ADR-0021)
body:
## Summary

Upgrades `@objectstack/spec` from `^8.0.1` to `^9.0.0` across the workspace and migrates the analytics surface to the ADR-0021 **single-form, dataset-bound** report shape.

Since 9.0 a report references its dataset's semantic layer — `rows` (dimension names) and `values` (measure names) are plain `string[]`; the inline `objectName` + `columns` + `groupingsDown` query form no longer validates.

### @object-ui/types (report bridge)
- `specReportToPresentation` maps `values`/`rows` through and leaves label / aggregation / sort / granularity to the dataset-aware renderer (lossy by construction)
- `isSpecReport` heuristic updated for the dataset-bound shape
- dropped the now-dead `aggregateToLegacy` helper

### Tests
- drill / SpecReportGrid / useReportData suites: fixtures rebuilt as plain legacy-shaped literals — these suites cover the stored pre-9.0 JSON **passthrough paths**, which remain in the renderer
- ReportRenderer dispatcher: typeless dataset-bound reports route to `DatasetReportRenderer`; typeless non-dataset schemas fall back to `LegacyReportRenderer`
- app-shell `report-schema`: asserts the spec-derived `dataset`/`rows`/`values` properties

### Explicitly out of scope
Retiring the legacy report surface (SpecReportGrid / MatrixRenderer / JoinedReportRenderer and the Studio report-authoring UI that depends on ColumnsEditor / GroupingsBuilder) cascades into live product features and needs a dataset-native editor first — that's a separate epic.

## Test plan

- [x] `pnpm build` — 41/41 tasks
- [x] `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console exec vite build` (CI's E2E build step)
